state.brief: CanBook must allow a verified contact or scoped host manager to move an appointment, retaining its old host and room until the replacement succeeds. Host and room reservations have separate authorities; neither shares an atomic transaction with appointment state. Current reserve replaces the same source after checking conflicts, while a new source conflicts with its own overlapping old appointment. Existing book, cancel and reserve declarations below are the actual source. Draft-only work may change provider contracts and state machines, but cannot claim runtime implementation or widen their existing caller/record permissions. Evaluate preserving the old slot under failures, overlapping moves, late completion and cancellation; simpler source is useful only when required behavior remains intact.

reschedule_design.instructions: Select the design whose stated tradeoffs best meet the supplied appointment requirements.

criteria.staged: Add staged replacements at each existing reservation owner: a fresh candidate source identifies the old source/revision, excludes only that old commitment from its conflict calculation, preserves old and candidate capacity until correlated completion, then the appointment adopts both candidates and releases its prior sources. This supports overlap and compensation but requires provider state and recovery semantics.
criteria.disjoint: Keep the current provider interfaces and allow fresh-source rescheduling only when the candidate does not overlap the old commitments. This preserves old capacity on failure with fewer provider changes, but prohibits otherwise valid overlapping moves.
criteria.coordinator: Move host and room authority into one new coordinator for atomic replacement. This could simplify all-or-nothing movement at that authority, but would require ownership transfers and a new architecture outside the existing independent owners.

current_guarantee.instructions: Do the present same-source reserve/move calls, sent independently, guarantee that failure at one provider cannot lose the original appointment slot?

criteria.true: The supplied current declarations alone establish old host and room preservation on every independent failure path.
criteria.false: At least one allowed independent outcome can replace old capacity before the other provider has succeeded, or the supplied declarations do not establish the required guarantee.
